findings.detail: Eight all-PIK debt rows have blank extracted interest_rate even though the source states the coupon entirely as PIK.

rationale: Class 2 review of the full source rows identifies exactly eight current-period debt positions whose Interest Rate cells contain PIK-only coupons. The extracted rows have neither interest_rate nor basis_spread, so the all-in coupon was dropped rather than absent or inapplicable. The correct interest_rate for each all-PIK position is its stated PIK coupon.
